basic_info.description: Welcome to 150 Beverly Street, located in the lively Merced Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. Semi-detached single house No hills to climb in this desirable location. This well preserved 1941 beauty has a fantastic floor-plan including a remodeled eat-in kitchen, formal dining & living rooms. Two large bedrooms opens onto a sunny backyard, ideal for relaxing or hosting gatherings truly a gardener's delight. The independently accessed permitted lower level includes a second full bath & can be used as a family room or bedroom. Gleaming hardwood floors through-out. Garage parking w/ internal access. Setback property with addition parking space. Nearby Merced Heights Playground and tennis courts, SFSU, H Mart, Stonestown, Target, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Regal Theater, City Sports, and YMCA. Convenient public transportation and easy access to HWY 280.
